subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should an explicitly configured agentDir become a trusted bootstrap prompt source, or should workspace remain the only bootstrap source with warnings for misplaced agentDir files?
rationale: The patch changes where safety and persona instructions can come from, while current docs make workspace the bootstrap source and an open warning-only PR offers a lower-risk alternative.

options.title: Keep workspace canonical with warnings
options.body: Preserve the current prompt-source boundary and pursue the warning-only path after maintainer/security confirmation.

options.title: Complete explicit agentDir precedence
options.body: Accept agentDir as prompt authority only after aligning diagnostics, docs, focused tests, and redacted real-run proof.

options.title: Pause for design
options.body: Keep the linked issue and candidate PRs open until maintainers decide the permanent bootstrap-source boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep workspace canonical with warnings
recommendation.body: Preserve the current prompt-source boundary and pursue the warning-only path after maintainer/security confirmation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history on the central bootstrap resolver and current doctor/bootstrap lines among the likely owners.
